messages:
kai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep seeing a pattern of cache-eviction spikes causing P99 decode stalls. Need clear owners for tests and a tracking plan.

kai: Action items I propose: 1) incident-derived prompt set + annotations (owner: @miriam) due Thu, 2) a deterministic regression harness that can replay warm vs cold (owner: @devin) due Mon, 3) a "warm->cold" k6 profile + nightly run (owner: @ash) due next Wed, 4) tighten postmortem board labels to surface recurring patterns (owner: @kai) due EOW.

miriam: I'll gather prompts from the last four incidents and tag each with seq_len, cache_state, and observed_latency_ms. Planning ~80 prompts initially with 12 adversarial variants (truncation, token storms). Will drop them in inference-evals/prompt-sets/incidents/182500 and include README.

devin: For the harness I'll add a --kv-seed flag and output CSV/JSON summaries: p50,p95,p99 for warm and cold and delta_pct. Will add unit tests to validate deterministic replay. Example command: ```./regress --suite cache_storm --artifact gs://redwood/incidents/182500 --model redwood-v2```

ash: k6 profile plan: baseline 150 qps, 10s ramp to 600 qps for 45s, simulate connection churn at end. Capture token-level latencies and runtime queue depth. I'll scope quotas with infra and make it runnable in staging for PRs and nightly.

kai: For tracking: I'm adding labels to the follow-up board: pattern:cache-eviction, impact:tail-latency, test:regression-suite. We'll use recurrence to bump priority.

ops-bot: Created tickets SRE-4101 (prompt set), SRE-4102 (regression harness), SRE-4103 (warm-cold k6).

miriam: q: where to store KV snapshots? gs://redwood-evals/incident-archives/182500 OK? will sanitize.

devin: OK, include a small sample seed and a script to load it into dev env. Also add a reproducibility note in the README.

ash: Note: if CI gating is enforced, we need an exemption flow for experiments. Suggest a temporary label `ci_latency_exempt` plus on-call approval recorded in the ticket.

kai: Agreed. Default non-blocking. If PR shows >20% regression on P95 we auto-notify oncall and create a blocking follow-up. Exemptions require oncall + eng-lead signoff.

miriam: I'll PR the prompt corpus and metadata today; will include instructions for marking adversarial cases.

devin: I'll open a draft PR with harness and sample output. Need runtime reviewers for KV schema.

ash: I'll schedule a staging smoke at 09:30 tomorrow and tag runtime oncall.

kai: I'll update the board and add the timeline: SRE-4101 due Thu, SRE-4102 due Mon, SRE-4103 due next Wed. We'll review in the retro next week. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: retro scheduled 2026-07-02 11:00.

miriam: :thumbsup: filing PR now.
